HEALTH:
if contract.l10n_sk_ztp:
    rate = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee_ztp')
else:
    rate = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee')
base = categories.GROSS
# Health OOP (odvodová odpočítateľná položka): reduces ONLY the employee health
# assessment base, for a regular employment relationship (not a dohoda), when
# claimed. OOP = max(0, max - slope*(gross - max)) with slope = max/(end-max)
# (380/190 = 2), so base = max(0, gross - OOP). The employer base is untouched.
if contract.l10n_sk_health_oop_claim and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type == 'none':
    oop_max = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_oop_max')
    oop_end = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_oop_phaseout_end')
    slope = oop_max / (oop_end - oop_max)
    oop = max(0.0, oop_max - slope * max(0.0, base - oop_max))
    # § 16 ods. 18: the allowance cannot exceed the income and is reduced by the
    # calendar days of the month without this employment.
    oop = min(oop, base) * contract.l10n_sk_month_employed_ratio(payslip.date_from)
    base = max(0.0, base - oop)
# §19 z.580/2004: floor the health preddavok DOWN to the eurocent.
result = -(int(round(base * rate, 4)) / 100.0)
result_rate = 100
# Štátny poistenec (student on DoBPŠ / working pensioner) pays no health
# insurance on agreement income (z. 580/2004).
if contract.l10n_sk_health_exempt:
    result = 0.0
HEALTHDOPLATOK:
# § 16a zákona 580/2004: the employer tops the employee's monthly preddavok
# up to the MINIMUM preddavok (ee + er premium on the životné minimum valid
# on 1 January, § 16a ods. 1; OOP not applied), and charges the difference to
# the employee (ods. 4). The minimum is reduced pro rata by every calendar
# day on which the person (ods. 2) was a poistenec štátu — PN with náhrada
# príjmu or nemocenské (§ 11 ods. 7), a student — was an "osoba so zdravotným
# postihnutím", or was not an employee at all. So:
#   * ZŤP (ZP) for the whole month -> no minimum at all (ods. 2 písm. c));
#   * a DoBPŠ student is a poistenec štátu (§ 11 ods. 7 písm. a)) -> none;
#   * PN days and days outside the contract shrink it proportionally.
# The annual true-up is the insurer's (§ 13b, § 19); this is the monthly
# advance only. A concurrent-employment opt-out (ods. 5) is not modelled.
if contract.l10n_sk_health_exempt or contract.l10n_sk_ztp or contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type == 'dobps':
    result = 0.0
else:
  min_base = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_min_base')
  rate_ee = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee')
  rate_er = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employer')
  # Each component is a preddavok, floored to the eurocent (§ 16 ods. 1).
  min_combined = (int(round(min_base * rate_ee, 4)) + int(round(min_base * rate_er, 4))) / 100.0
  period_days = (payslip.date_to - payslip.date_from).days + 1
  emp_from = payslip.date_from
  emp_to = payslip.date_to
  # Contract dates are HR-manager fields; a payroll officer must still
  # be able to compute the slip.
  c_start = contract.sudo().contract_date_start
  c_end = contract.sudo().contract_date_end
  if c_start and c_start > emp_from:
    emp_from = c_start
  if c_end and c_end < emp_to:
    emp_to = c_end
  days = max(0, (emp_to - emp_from).days + 1)
  # PN calendar days: the PN_DAYS input when given; otherwise the PN leave's
  # calendar days inside this period.
  if 'PN_DAYS' in inputs.dict:
    pn_days = inputs.PN_DAYS.amount
  elif 'PN' in worked_days.dict:
    _split = payslip.l10n_sk_pn_split(0, 0)
    pn_days = _split[2] if _split else abs(worked_days.dict['PN'].number_of_days)
  else:
    pn_days = 0.0
  days = max(0.0, days - pn_days)
  if days < period_days:
    min_combined = int(round(min_combined * days / period_days * 100.0, 4)) / 100.0
  actual_combined = abs(result_rules.HEALTH.total) + result_rules.HEALTHEMPLOYER.total
  result = -max(0.0, round(min_combined - actual_combined, 2))
